name: Astra Mini S
summary: Astra Mini S is a compact structured-light RGB-D module for embedded indoor perception. Its 0.4–2 m working range and USB 2.0 interface support close-range service-robot sensing and industrial inspection. Orbbec has ended marketing while continuing scheduled support through May 2028.

sources.quote:
EOL Announcement for Astra Mini S
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of
technological innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone
points for the Astra Mini S . We hope this information will serve as a reference for your
future product planning and development.
Orbbec Inc.
December 15, 2025
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2025-12-15 EOL publicity date
EOM 2026-05-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date
when the product stops accepting orders,
including orders for new sites and capacity
expansion. After that date, the product will no
longer be sold.
EOS 2028-05-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last
date of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec
does not provide any service for the product.
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Astra Mini S Astra Mini S Pro
